attachesAs: a dependent long-e sign written before and to the left of the primary consonant, though pronounced after it
compositionOrder: in handwriting, write the ē vowel sign to the left before the primary consonant
write the Tamil consonant carrier after it; read the result as consonant plus ē

compositionSource.citation: Sankaran Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Module 7, Frame 7: the secondary symbol for ē is written before the primary consonant (University of Texas at Austin, 2009)
compositionSource.variation: Module 7 verifies the handwritten sign-before-carrier order and the sign's left-side placement. It does not supply a standalone directional path or pen-lift count, so no ductus is inferred.
